versions.changelog:
Initial release of the patent invalidation analysis skill.

- Supports input verification (filing date and completeness of technical solution).
- Structures patent information into technical problem, means, and effect.
- Extracts and lists independent technical features for comparison.
- Performs targeted prior art search using Google Patents or alternatives.
- Ranks and evaluates prior art based on similarity for invalidity grounds.
- Guides generation of comprehensive invalidation analysis reports in Word format.
